explanation: The statement is entirely about the library's own definitions: `Cser p B := PowerSeries.mk fun n ↦ -coeff (n*p) B`, `kForm p h` (the Fricke-slash of `h` by `fricke p`), and the library-level `ModularForm.heckeU`/`ModularFormClass.qCoeff_heckeU` facts. Searched Mathlib for `Cser`, `kForm`, `fricke`/`Fricke`, `heckeU`, and `qExpansion_kForm`: Mathlib has only `qExpansion` (`Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/QExpansion.lean`) and no Fricke/conjugate operator, no `Cser`, and no `heckeU`; so there is no Mathlib declaration stating this identity about q-expansions of the Fricke transform. The proof uses Mathlib lemmas (`qExpansion_neg`, `PowerSeries.coeff_map`) only as ingredients, which does not make a duplicate.
